extDescription.message: Save the page you are on, a link or the text you selected to your Leafdesk workspace.

optionsHelp.message: The address you open Leafdesk at, like https://leafdesk.example.com.

optionsSaved.message: Saved. Pages you save open in Leafdesk's quick note.

optionsInvalid.message: Enter a web address, like https://leafdesk.example.com.

optionsHowButton.message: Click the extension's button (or press Alt+Shift+S) to save the page you are on, with the text you selected on it as a quote.

optionsHowMenu.message: Right-click a page, a link or selected text and choose Save to Leafdesk.

optionsHowSignIn.message: Leafdesk opens in a new tab: choose where it goes, or save the whole page. Sign in there if you aren't yet.
